lines.rookie: The piece went missing at midnight, in ten dark minutes. Enzo and Livia saw the lights go off. But the power stayed on: someone turned the lights off by hand. A white dust trail led to the back door. There, the Owl left a card: the piece is not lost.

lines.master: The piece vanished at midnight, in ten minutes of darkness. Enzo and Livia both saw the lights go off, yet the power had never failed: someone had switched the lights off by hand. A trail of white dust led to the back door, where the Owl had left a card insisting that the piece is not lost.

lines.master: Nothing but the dust trail here. Follow it to the door.

lines.rookie: Where do people throw coins and make a wish? Tap one picture.
lines.junior: Where do people throw coins and make a wish? Tap one picture.
lines.master: Where do people throw coins and make a wish? Tap one picture.

lines.rookie: inside a round temple, sunlight falling through a round hole in the roof
lines.junior: inside a round temple, with sunlight falling through a round hole in the roof
lines.master: inside a round temple, sunlight pouring through a round hole in the roof

lines.rookie: a great fountain of rushing water, a girl throwing a coin into it
lines.junior: a great fountain of rushing water, with a girl throwing a coin into it
lines.master: a magnificent fountain of rushing water, a girl tossing a coin into it

lines.rookie: a huge round stone arena with rows of arches
lines.junior: a huge round stone arena with rows of arches
lines.master: a vast round stone arena ringed with rows of arches

lines.rookie: THE FOUNTAIN OF WISHES
lines.junior: THE FOUNTAIN OF WISHES
lines.master: THE FOUNTAIN OF WISHES

lines.rookie: The Owl says the piece is not lost. Next stop: the Trevi Fountain.
lines.junior: The Owl says the piece is not lost. Your next stop is the Trevi Fountain.
lines.master: The Owl claims the piece is not lost. Your next destination: the Trevi Fountain.

lines.rookie: How many places did my dust trail pass?
lines.junior: How many places did my dust trail pass?
lines.master: How many places did my dust trail pass?

lines.rookie: How many people saw the lights go off?
lines.junior: How many people saw the lights go off?
lines.master: How many people saw the lights go off?

lines.rookie: The Light Box
lines.junior: The Light Box
lines.master: The Light Box

lines.rookie: The big light box is in the guard room.
lines.junior: The big light box stands in the guard room.
lines.master: The big light box stands against the guard room wall.

lines.rookie: Someone put a new lock on it, with three dials.
lines.junior: Someone has put a new lock on it, with three dials.
lines.master: Someone has fitted it with a new lock, with three dials.

lines.rookie: A tag with an owl stamp hangs from the lock.
lines.junior: A tag with an owl stamp is hanging from the lock.
lines.master: A tag bearing an owl stamp dangles from the lock.

lines.rookie: The owl tag says:
lines.junior: The owl tag says:
lines.master: The owl tag says:

lines.rookie:
My lock is made of your first clues, Detective.
First number: How many places did my dust trail pass?
Second number: How many people saw the lights go off at midnight?
Third number: Which shell did I write about on my card?
— The Owl
lines.junior:
My lock is built from your first clues, Detective.
First number: How many places did my dust trail pass?
Second number: How many people saw the lights go off at midnight?
Third number: Which shell did I write about on my card?
— The Owl
lines.master:
My lock is built from the very first clues you gathered, Detective.
First number: How many places did my dust trail pass?
Second number: How many people saw the lights go off at midnight?
Third number: Which shell did I mention on my card?
— The Owl

lines.rookie: Turn the dials to the Owl's three numbers. Then open the light box.
lines.junior: Turn the dials to the Owl's three numbers, then open the light box.
lines.master: Set the dials to the Owl's three numbers, then open the light box.

lines.rookie: Your notebook has the dust trail. Count its places.
lines.junior: Your notebook has the dust trail. Count how many places it passed.
lines.master: The dust trail is waiting in your notebook. How many stops did it make?

lines.rookie: Open your witness notes. Who saw the lights go off?
lines.junior: Open your witness notes. Who saw the lights go off?
lines.master: Reread your witness notes. Whose stories agreed about the dark?

lines.rookie: The light box opens!
lines.junior: The light box opens!
lines.master: The light box opens!

lines.rookie: White dust on the switch, and an owl card at the door.
lines.junior: White dust on the switch, and an owl card at the door.
lines.master: White dust on the switch, and an owl card left at the door.

lines.rookie: Somebody planned the dark ten minutes.
lines.junior: Somebody had planned the dark ten minutes.
lines.master: The dark ten minutes had been carefully planned.

lines.rookie: Giulia holds up the Owl's card. "To the Trevi Fountain!"
lines.junior: Giulia holds up the Owl's card. "To the Trevi Fountain!"
lines.master: Giulia raises the Owl's card triumphantly. "To the Trevi Fountain!"

lines.rookie: Count the places on the trail again. The empty case is one of them.
lines.junior: Count the places on the trail again. Remember, the empty case is one of them.
lines.master: Recount the trail's places. Don't forget where it began: the empty case counts too.

lines.rookie: Open your witness notes. More than one person saw the lights go off.
lines.junior: Open your witness notes. More than one person saw the lights go off.
lines.master: Check your witness notes again. Only one witness? Look more closely.

lines.rookie: Read the Owl's card again. Which shell?
lines.junior: Read the Owl's card again. Which shell did it mention?
lines.master: Return to the Owl's card. Which shell did it name?

lines.rookie: Count again. Who saw the lights go off? Not Sofia.
lines.junior: Count again. Who saw the lights go off? Sofia didn't.
lines.master: Recount carefully. Sofia never saw the lights go off.

lines.rookie: These numbers fit, but not in this order. Trail, witnesses, then the shell.
lines.junior: These numbers are right, but not in this order. Trail first, then witnesses, then the shell.
lines.master: The right numbers, in the wrong order. Trail first, then witnesses, then the shell.

lines.rookie: The lid opens. The big switch is down.
lines.junior: The lid swings open. The big switch has been pushed down.
lines.master: The lid creaks open. The big switch is down.

lines.rookie: But the power never went off!
lines.junior: But the power never went off!
lines.master: But the power never failed for a moment!

lines.rookie: Someone turned the lights off by hand.
lines.junior: Someone switched the lights off by hand.
lines.master: Someone switched the lights off deliberately, by hand.

lines.rookie: So this was a plan, not an accident.
lines.junior: So this was planned. It wasn't an accident.
lines.master: So this was a carefully laid plan, not an accident.

lines.rookie: There is white dust on the switch, too.
lines.junior: There is white dust on the switch, too.
lines.master: A smear of white dust clings to the switch, too.

lines.rookie: Who is this Owl? Let's follow the card!
lines.junior: Who is this Owl? Let's follow the card!
lines.master: Who on earth is this Owl? Let's follow the card!
